import json

from collections import defaultdict

# Load queue
with open('outputs/02c_ASYNC_QUEUE_W4B13_1771254431.json') as f:
    queue_data = json.load(f)

items = queue_data['items']
print(f"Processing {len(items)} items from batch", file=sys.stderr)

# Common KZG-related functions to search for
kzg_functions = [
    'verify_cell_kzg_proof_batch',
    'verify_cell_kzg_proof_batch_impl',
    'recover_cells_and_kzg_proofs',
    'coset_for_cell',
    'coset_shift_for_cell',
    'VerifyCellKZGProofBatch',
    'RecoverCellsAndKZGProofs',
]

# Extract all unique function/symbol references from all items
all_symbols = set()
symbol_to_items = defaultdict(list)

for item in items:
    check_id = item['check_id']
    title = item.get('title', '')
    test_procedure = item.get('test_procedure', '')
    
    # Look for function patterns
    text = f"{title} {test_procedure}"
    
    # Go function patterns (both snake_case and CamelCase)
    patterns = [
        r'\b([a-z][a-z0-9_]*(?:_[a-z0-9]+){2,})\b',  # snake_case with multiple underscores
        r'\b(Verify[A-Z][a-zA-Z0-9]*)\b',  # VerifyXxx pattern
        r'\b(Recover[A-Z][a-zA-Z0-9]*)\b',  # RecoverXxx pattern
        r'\b([A-Z][a-z]+[A-Z][a-zA-Z0-9]*)\b',  # CamelCase
    ]
    
    found_symbols = set()
    for pattern in patterns:
        matches = re.findall(pattern, text)
        for match in matches:
            if len(match) > 5:  # Filter short names
                all_symbols.add(match)
                found_symbols.add(match)
                symbol_to_items[match].append(check_id)
    
    # Store which symbols were found for this item
    item['_extracted_symbols'] = list(found_symbols)

# Save enriched queue for processing
output_data = {
    'items': items,
    'all_symbols': sorted(list(all_symbols)),
    'symbol_count': len(all_symbols)
}

with open('/tmp/enriched_queue.json', 'w') as f:
    json.dump(output_data, f, indent=2)

print(f"Extracted {len(all_symbols)} unique symbols", file=sys.stderr)

sorted_symbols = sorted(symbol_to_items.items(), key=lambda x: len(x[1]), reverse=True)
